verdict.rationale: The Fellow API documents only per-item mutation endpoints, such as marking a single action item complete, archiving one action item, or editing one note's agenda. It also offers paginated list endpoints for reads. These are building blocks a developer could loop over, not a documented bulk or batch operation. The Super Admin API's workspace-wide retrieve/export/delete describes access scope across users rather than a multi-item bulk action, so no first-party bulk-operation capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
